item.title: CHANGE OF SERVICE: Please Re-Enroll In The Nibble RSS Feed
item.description: Dear Nibble Reader: We've upgraded our Nibble RSS feed, and need you to take a moment of your time to subscribe to the new feed. Just go to http://www.thenibble.com/rss/index.asp and click on the General Feed box. Then, you'll get the same feed as before, with no interruption. We've also added several new feeds that may be of interest to you. We've also converted our weekly Gourmet News And Views to a daily blog. Take a look, at http://blog.thenibble.com.
